changes_made.explanation: Added Visual Question Answering as a secondary task since the paper involves multimodal QA formats. Removed SD-v2.1 as it's the model used for dataset generation, not an evaluation dataset. Clarified outputs to better reflect both vision and language modality tasks.
Normalized metric names to standard capitalization. Removed redundant metrics (N/A filtered bias score is a variant of Bias Score, and similarity is the same as Output Similarity).
No LLM-as-judge evaluation used in this paper. LVLMs are used for generation but not for post-hoc evaluation of outputs.
No human evaluation conducted in this study - all evaluation is automated using the proposed metrics.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on measuring stereotypical bias in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) using automated metrics. The main NLG tasks are image captioning and visual question answering where models generate spatial locations and social group classifications. The evaluation is entirely automated using custom bias metrics rather than human or LLM-based assessment.
